name: Checkout Field Editor for WooCommerce
author: Scott Paterson

sections.description:
This plugin lets you easily disable default WooCommerce checkout fields – helping you create a faster, cleaner, and more user-friendly checkout experience.

By simplifying the checkout process, you can reduce friction for customers, minimize distractions, and potentially lower cart abandonment rates. A dedicated settings page is added under the WooCommerce admin menu, giving you full control with no coding required.

In the future, we will expand this plugin to support other plugins like Easy Digital Downloads.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/checkout-field-editor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Checkout Fields to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Where are the settings located?

You’ll find the settings page under the WooCommerce admin menu as ‘Checkout Fields.’ You can also access it via the ‘Settings’ link on the Plugins page next to this plugin.

Can I remove custom fields or only default WooCommerce fields?

Currently, this plugin only supports disabling default WooCommerce checkout fields.

Will this plugin speed up my checkout process?

Yes! By reducing the number of fields a customer has to fill out, you can create a faster, more seamless checkout experience and potentially reduce cart abandonment rates.

Is this plugin compatible with page builders or checkout layout plugins?

Yes, this plugin works alongside most WooCommerce-compatible themes and checkout enhancement tools.

Is there support for Easy Digital Downloads (EDD)?

Not yet, but we plan to expand support to other platforms like EDD in upcoming versions.
